title: Cute but short battery life
text: Cute but short battery life. These were cute but the batteries died pretty quickly. Less than 48 total hours I would guess (not straight - off and on through 2 weeks of holidays).  We only used the 2 blue strands in glasses to accent our holiday decor so they weren’t on much but they didn’t make it through Christmas and we are late decorators and only had them on a couple hours each night.

features: Light string is submersible but battery pack not submersible.
